new_results.statement: For exact rank three A=R Lambda R^T, fair original-coordinate half-cut S satisfies E det(G_S)det(I-G_S)=D0/64, and some cut obeys sigma_3(A[S,S^c]) >= s sqrt(D0)/8.
Volume-basis inclusion probability equals row leverage c_i, hence max_i c_i >= (1-D0)/3; with zero diagonal and no pair above delta s the heavy physical row has effective support >(1-D0)/(3 delta^2).

There are exact-spectrum {1,1,-2}, zero-diagonal Parseval null frames with N+3 distinct projective rays and 0<D0<=8 epsilon^3 for arbitrary N; a fixed finite ray-count conclusion for positive small D0 is false. The family is paid by the physical-pair branch and is not a QFORM counterexample.
